text:
Nora (AE): FYI we received an RFP from AstraNova Therapeutics. They want a completed capability matrix, security questionnaire, a short POC runbook, and explicit pricing for Reserved vs Hosted-burst including an HSM add-on. Deadline = 72 hours. I uploaded the starter sheet: https://redwood.app/files/astranova_rfp_seed.xlsx

Ethan - Solutions: Quick notes: peak ask is ~6k embeddings qps sustained for short windows. Two viable approaches: 1) Dedicated reserved pool (we can scope SLA during reserved hours), 2) Hosted with autoscale + fallback model (no hard GPU SLA). Need to confirm preferred model (they leaned Dedicated in the call).

Priya (Infra): From infra perspective 6k qps => recommended baseline 8 x A100-80GB w/ NVLink, dynamic batching up to 512, KV cache for prefix reuse. If they pick Private deployment (their VPC), HSM integration will require an on-site validation window (~48-72 hrs). I'll draft the config snippet and peering checklist.

Lydia (Security): Reviewed their questionnaire. Major items to address:
- BYOK / HSM: support for customer-managed keys and key-wrap. For on-prem HSM we need architecture review + attestation.
- Audit logs: they want SIEM integration; we can stream logs to S3 or push to a syslog endpoint (note cost for long-term retention).
- Incident notification: they requested <1hr notification; legal must approve.
I'll attach SOC2 and our KMS guide.

Ethan - Solutions: I'll fill the capability matrix with measurements for two model variants (fp16 and 8-bit quant). Also will add a POC ops checklist: bench command, success KPIs (qps, p99 latency < 120ms), monitoring hooks, rollback criteria. Example bench command:
```
ri bench --model redwood-embed-v4 --concurrency 150 --batch-max 512 --duration 600
```
I'll include a canary fallback plan (traffic shaping + model downgrade) and a small pricing appendix for 1h/8h/24h cases.

Priya (Infra): Draft network/peering steps: required CIDRs, ports (443, 8443), expected egress estimate. Note: if they want cross-account KMS, we need to exchange IAM role details and confirm key policies. I'll add that to the matrix.

Lydia (Security): Uploading attachments: SOC2: https://redwood.app/security/soc2_2025.pdf; KMS guide: https://redwood.app/docs/kms-hsm-integration. Flagging HSM attestation to Legal.

proc-bot: POC sandbox job scheduled: ci/astranova-poc-sbox queued (eta 1829993200).

Nora (AE): Action items:
- Ethan: capability matrix + POC ops checklist + pricing appendix (due tomorrow EOD)
- Priya: infra snippet + peering + KMS steps (due tomorrow EOD)
- Lydia: security questionnaire answers + attachments (due in 2 business days)
I'll assemble and send once drafts are in.

Ethan - Solutions: Will add a small HSM add-on line in pricing (one-time validation fee + hourly test window).

Priya (Infra): Note for pricing: Private deployment remote validation has an ops engineering day-rate. Will list as optional.

Lydia (Security): One more ask from them: do we provide tamper-evident audit trails? We can outline current audit capabilities and add an optional attestation if they need FIPS-level proofs.

Nora (AE): Good call. Add audit trail options to the matrix. If Legal needs anything, ping me.

Ethan - Solutions: Uploading draft matrix in a bit. Marking thread for follow-up. :thumbsup:

proc-bot: Sandbox deployed at 1829993187. Logs: https://redwood.app/ci/astranova-sbox/logs

Nora (AE): Thanks team. Keep updates here and I'll coordinate procurement contact once ready.
